fact: Biometric Update reports Tanzania is launching an ITU-backed innovation hub, one of 17 ITU Acceleration Centers worldwide, which received final approval at the ITU Digital Innovation Board in Geneva and is to be managed by the ICT Commission, with the launch described as imminent.
Vodacom Tanzania says its Vodacom Digital Accelerator, launched in 2019 as a season-based programme, has supported startups in healthcare, agriculture, education and financial services.

Daily News reports COSTECH launched the Tanzania Ventures Lab, implemented with DTBi, Buni Innovation Hub and Sahara Ventures, supporting about 250 startups a year to 2029 through structured acceleration programmes.

InnoIP Tanzania, launched 22-23 August 2026 in Tanga, is run through the Dar Teknohama Business Incubator (DTBi) and Buni Innovation Hub, with a first-year target of 120 innovators taken through seven stages ending in investor linkage.
